equityAnalysis.summary: North Haledon Borough maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In North Haledon Borough, homeowners pay an average of $12,777.88 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.94% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 64.15%, assessed values average ~64.15% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 53.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 30.1%, and Passaic County claims 16.1%.
